expectation.stresses: A .psm1 generated at build time, holding several hundred functions in one file, with nested helper functions inside other functions. Size, single-file attribution, and the difference between a top-level function and a local one.
expectation.predicted: Succeeds and is the slowest run in the corpus by a wide margin. Node count exceeds the declared export count several times over, because functions defined inside other functions are found by the same recursive search and become top-level nodes. Two functions sharing a name in different scopes collapse to one entry in the name index.
